Google is a popular search engine/Portal based in California. Deja
has recently been selling off as much of themselves as they can, and
thankfully someone saw the usefulness of the archive and purchased it
before it went down in flames (I felt that Deja was going to
eventually die).

Google's press release claims they plan on putting up a new web
interface and allowing posting in the future. Specifically when they
did not say unfortunately.

Hello Rob,

The Google is nothing but a search engine that does not support posting, at
this time, but intend to support it in the future. All this according to the
information they provide. My question would be "when is the future?",
tomorrow, next week, next month, next year, etc...

I have been trying to find a good alternative and seem to have found one at
<http://newsone.net>

The service is free, though I am unsure as to the posting speed. As for
Google, it may be fast but the database it is searching can be up to 36 hours
behind the powercurve. Again, information they provide.

I really have to hand it to Deja, they certainly need a good kick in the
backside for this change over.
